entities.summary: The Mukha class, Soviet designation Project 11451 Sokol  (falcon), was a class of hydrofoil patrol corvettes built for the Soviet Navy. Designated with the NATO reporting name Mukha class, it consisted of anti-submarine hydrofoils, used primarily for experimental purposes. The ships were built by PO More Shipyard in Feodosya, which had a broad experience in hydrofoil shipbuilding.
